item.title: Large truck fire shuts down Montgomery Drive on-ramp to westbound Schuylkill Expressway
item.description: A large truck fire shut down the Montgomery Drive on-ramp to the westbound Schuylkill Expressway early Monday morning. Philadelphia firefighters blocked the ramp while they worked to get the flames under control.The fire was seen coming from the back of the truck as crews arrived.
